title: 第11章 谈话第12章 开销计算
slug: 落魄贵族千金被迫成为我的女仆
lines: ：“那你这个成年的标准也太低了吧。”
叶海吐槽道。
艾莎夫人长长的睫毛眨了眨，蓝宝石一般的眼眸中透露出一丝疑惑：“低吗？不一直都是这样。”
“我当年也是在这个年纪结的婚，然后过了一年就生下了蒂芙尼这个孩子。”
所以你前夫死了啊！
他该死！
叶海忍不住默默的翻了个白眼，也就是在这种中世纪一样的大陆才会出现这种情况。
不过倒也正常，因为这个时代的人寿命实在是太短了。
多数普通人三四十岁就算是高寿了。
一方面是生活质量太低，人们的身体素质普遍较低。
另一方面是医疗水平太差，多数普通人即使生病了都看不起医生，只能依靠身体硬扛。
正所谓小病扛，大病死。
而且就算是小毛小病，这样硬扛过去也容易扣最大生命值。
也就是俗话说的减寿。
“反正对于我来说，蒂芙尼还是太小了，再等两年吧。”
叶海摇了摇头，虽然蒂芙尼对于明斯克大陆的人来说已经成年了，但对他来说还是太小了，下不去手。
“要是现在成婚，她不小心怀孕就麻烦了。”
“年龄那么小，很容易出现难产的情况。”
叶海这一世的母亲当年就是因为生他的时候难产，虽然最后顺利的生下了他，但也因为难产的缘故元气大伤，没多久就去世了。
这个世界也没有什么避孕的手段，一切都全看运气。
“太早生孩子会难产吗？”
艾莎夫人下意识用手抚摸了一下自己的小腹，当年自己生孩子确实也挺困难的。
但好在最后挺过来了。
艾莎夫人低头陷入沉思，当年可没有人和她说过这些。
虽然艾莎夫人不知道叶海的这些奇怪理论知识都是哪里来的，但以往的事实证明，到最后他总是正确的。
“所以这就是你把琉璃川千代留在身边的原因吗？”
艾莎夫人若有所思：“看来你喜欢的是她这样的女生。”
也是，当年的枫叶老伯爵可是专门为此帮叶海向琉璃川公国求娶琉璃川千代，只不过被拒绝了。
“不，我其实还有更喜欢的类型。”
叶海摇头反驳。
艾莎夫人饶有兴致的问道：“是什么类型？”
叶海嘴角泛起一丝弧度，没有回答，而是反问道：“夫人，你现在低头能看见放在小腹上的手吗？”
艾莎夫人听到这个问题，下意识的低头看了一眼，却被胸前的饱满挡住了视线。
“有道是低头不见脚尖，便已是人间绝色。”
叶海感叹道：“而夫人您显然已经有了这种天赋。”
艾莎夫人瓷白的脸颊上泛起了一丝红晕，她有些恼怒：“你这孩子，怎么还调侃起我来了。”
她白了叶海一眼：“算了，不说这些了，说正事。”
“你之前让人提炼的精盐，我已经让人运到其他贵族的领地售卖了，你猜销量怎么样？”
之前说过，在叶海之前，领地内的盐田是非常重要的收入组成之一。
不过那种海盐都十分粗糙，不仅泛黄结块，而且在食用的过程中有时候还会有异味。
content_en:
: "Then your adult standards are too low."
Ye Hai complained.
Mrs. Elsa's long eyelashes blinked, and there was a hint of doubt in her sapphire eyes: "Is it low? It's not always like this."
"I also got married at this age, and then gave birth to my child Tiffany a year later."
So your ex-husband is dead!
He deserves to die!
Ye Hai couldn't help but rolled his eyes silently, that is, this kind of situation would only happen in this medieval continent.
But that's normal, because the life span of people in this era is really too short.
Most ordinary people are considered old in their thirties and forties.
On the one hand, the quality of life is too low, and people's physical fitness is generally low.
On the other hand, the level of medical care is so poor that most ordinary people cannot afford to see a doctor even if they are sick and can only rely on their bodies to cope.
As the saying goes, you can carry a small illness but die from a serious one.
And even if it's just a minor ailment, just carrying it through like this can easily deduct your maximum health points.
That's what the saying goes, shortening one's lifespan.
"Anyway, Tiffany is still too young for me. Let's wait another two years."
Ye Hai shook his head. Although Tiffany was already an adult for people from the Minsk mainland, she was still too young for him to do anything.
"If she gets married now, she will be in trouble if she accidentally gets pregnant."
"At such a young age, it is easy for difficult labor to occur."
Ye Hai's mother in this life suffered from dystocia when giving birth to him. Although she gave birth to him smoothly in the end, her vitality was severely damaged due to the dystocia, and she died not long after.
There is no method of contraception in this world, everything depends on luck.
"Will it be difficult to have a baby if you give birth too early?"
Mrs. Aisha subconsciously touched her lower abdomen with her hand. It was indeed difficult to give birth to a child back then.
But luckily I got through it in the end.
Mrs. Aisha lowered her head and fell into deep thought. No one told her this back then.
Although Mrs. Aisha didn't know where Ye Hai's strange theoretical knowledge came from, past facts proved that he was always right in the end.
"So is this why you kept Rurigawa Chiyo by your side?"
Mrs. Aisha thoughtfully said: "It seems that you like girls like her."
Also, the old Earl Maple Leaf specifically helped Ye Hai to propose to the Liulicuan Principality to marry Liulicuan Chiyo, but was rejected.
"No, I actually have a better type."
Ye Hai shook his head and retorted.
Mrs. Aisha asked with interest: "What type is it?"
The corner of Ye Hai's mouth curled up, but instead of answering, he asked: "Madam, can you see the hand on your belly when you look down now?"
When Mrs. Aisha heard this question, she subconsciously glanced down, but her sight was blocked by the fullness of her chest.
"There is a saying that if you lower your head and don't see your toes, you are already the most beautiful person in the world."
Ye Hai sighed: "And madam, you obviously already have this talent."
There was a blush on Mrs. Aisha's porcelain cheeks, and she was a little annoyed: "You kid, why are you teasing me?"
She rolled her eyes at Ye Hai: "Forget it, let's not talk about this anymore, let's talk about business."
"I've already had the salt you refined previously transported to other nobles' territories for sale. What do you think the sales volume will be like?"
As mentioned before, before Ye Hai, the salt fields in the territory were one of the most important sources of income.
However, that kind of sea salt is very rough, not only turns yellow and clumps, but also sometimes smells bad when eaten.
